name: Mistmere
about: Niflheim, realm of ice, mist and water. Mistmere is a ring of pale-stone houses on the shore of a vast frozen lake: bridges of ice, a neon-blue cold-fire lantern on every post, frost runes on the gates and the aurora pouring green and violet over black mountains. Arrival from Bifrost through the ice arch; the Frost-Speaker's hall on the north terrace; the Quiet Shore path east; the cave stair west to the Glowpool Caverns.

exits.label: the cave stair to the Glowpool Caverns

portals.label: the ice arch back to Bifrost Crossing

actors.name: Frost-Speaker Gudrun Hoarwick

actors.name: Tove Lanternwright
say: Eat. Mistmere hasn't had a guest in years.

actors.name: Ketil Icehook

actors.name: Mistmere villager

actors.name: Mistmere villager
